sections.h2: What Does ERPNext HR and Payroll Cover?

paragraphs.text: ERPNext handles HR and payroll through Frappe HR, an open-source app that runs alongside ERPNext's accounts. It covers employee records, attendance, leave, salary structures, payroll runs, loans, expense claims and final settlements, with every payroll posted straight to the books. A typical Gulf payroll setup takes 3–6 weeks for one country and 6–10 weeks for several.

Frappe HR GCC setups add the rules each Gulf country needs. Our ERPNext HR GCC projects start with your labour contracts, salary components and bank, not with screens. ERPNext payroll setup GCC work is tested with a full parallel payroll run before your first live month.

sections.h2: Why Gulf Payroll Breaks on Spreadsheets

paragraphs.text: Gulf payroll mixes several rules at once: different leave entitlements per contract, overtime at different rates, gratuity based on years of service and reason for leaving, social insurance only for nationals, and bank files that reject a single wrong digit. Spreadsheets handle each rule separately, so errors appear at the worst time, usually in a final settlement. ERPNext HR & payroll GCC setups apply every rule from one set of employee records, so the numbers agree everywhere.

sections.h2: GCC Payroll Rules We Set Up
rows: WPS salary file through your bank

paragraphs.text: Each country's setup follows its own labour law, inside one system. ERPNext payroll UAE and ERPNext payroll Saudi Arabia setups are the most common, because those two countries have the largest private-sector workforces. ERPNext payroll Qatar and ERPNext payroll Oman projects add their own WPS formats, while ERPNext payroll Bahrain and ERPNext payroll Kuwait setups focus on social insurance for nationals and end-of-service for expatriate staff. Always confirm rates and rules with your adviser, because Gulf labour regulations are updated often.

Most Gulf countries require private-sector salaries to be paid through a Wage Protection System. ERPNext WPS setups calculate net pay, then export the salary file your bank or exchange house needs. For the UAE, ERPNext WPS UAE produces the Salary Information File, also called the ERPNext SIF file, with employee IDs, bank details and salary breakdown.

Every ERPNext WPS file is checked before release for missing labour card numbers, wrong IBANs and mismatched salary amounts, which are the most common causes of bank rejections. For Saudi Arabia, ERPNext Mudad setups produce the salary file in the format Mudad expects.

sections.intro: ERPNext gratuity calculation follows each country's rules, based on length of service, basic wage and the reason for leaving.

items.text: UAE: 21 days' basic wage for each of the first five years, then 30 days for each further year, capped at two years' total wage. ERPNext gratuity UAE setups apply this automatically.
Saudi Arabia: half a month's wage for each of the first five years and a full month for each year after, reduced on resignation according to length of service.
Qatar: at least three weeks' basic wage for each year of service.

outro.text: ERPNext EOSB calculation also accrues the liability every month, so your balance sheet always shows what you owe. ERPNext end of service GCC reports list each employee's entitlement on any date, which helps with budgeting and audits.

paragraphs.text: When an employee leaves, ERPNext brings together unpaid salary, leave encashment, gratuity, air ticket entitlement, loan balances and any deductions into one settlement statement. HR reviews it, finance approves it and the payment is posted with the right accounting entries. Every ERPNext HR & payroll GCC project we run tests final settlements for resignation, termination and end of contract before go-live, because these are the cases most likely to lead to disputes.

ERPNext GOSI setups calculate employer and employee contributions for Saudi and non-Saudi staff, with contribution reports ready for each month. The same approach covers GPSSA in the UAE, the Social Protection Fund in Oman, SIO in Bahrain, PIFSS in Kuwait and GRSIA in Qatar for nationals. Rates are stored as settings, so when a rate changes, it is updated once and applied to the next payroll. Contribution history stays on each employee record, which makes audits and disputes far easier to handle.

paragraphs.text: ERPNext leave management GCC setups follow each contract's rules. ERPNext attendance GCC imports punches from biometric devices or mobile check-ins, so overtime and absences flow straight to payroll. ERPNext air ticket allowance accrues each month, and ERPNext visa expiry tracking sends reminders weeks before renewal is due.

Many groups employ staff in two or three Gulf countries, often with a team in India too. Each company keeps its own payroll rules, currency and bank file, while HR managers see one employee list and group-wide reports. Transfers between group companies keep the employee's service history, so gratuity is calculated on the full period where the contract says it should be. ERPNext payroll GCC setups make month-end payroll one process instead of six spreadsheets. Our ERPNext payroll middle east clients use the same structure across borders.

Salary advances and staff loans are recorded with their repayment schedules, and instalments are deducted automatically each month. Every payroll run posts to the right expense, liability and bank accounts, split by department, project or cost centre. Managers see payroll cost by site or project, which matters for contractors and facility management firms that bill clients for manpower. Choosing ERPNext HR & payroll GCC finance teams can audit means every figure on the payslip can be traced back to its source.

paragraphs.text: Opening gratuity balances matter most, and they are where an ERPNext HR & payroll GCC project is won or lost. We carry forward each employee's joining date and past service, so final settlements are correct from the first day. This ERPNext HR implementation GCC process keeps salaries on time throughout.

items.q: Can staff apply for leave on mobile?
items.a: Yes. Employees can apply for leave, check balances, download payslips and submit expense claims from their phones, and managers approve requests the same way.

items.q: Can one system run payroll for several Gulf countries?
items.a: Yes. Each company keeps its own payroll rules, currency and bank file, while HR sees one combined view. Many groups also run Indian payroll in the same ERPNext system.

The price depends on the number of countries, employees and salary components, and on how much history needs to be carried forward. ERPNext and Frappe HR have no licence fee. Any ERPNext HR & payroll GCC partner should send a fixed quote after reviewing your contracts, and we do.

items.q: How long does payroll setup take?
items.a: One country usually takes 3–6 weeks, including a parallel payroll run. Groups with several countries take 6–10 weeks. A reliable ERPNext HR & payroll GCC partner will commit to these dates in writing.
